facts: Parties: Saltash Logistics plc (Buyer), Vantage Bioscience plc (Seller); the Company is Hartwell Pharma plc.
This Agreement is dated 10 February 2027; Closing is scheduled for 22 April 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 3 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $6,500,000, capped at $10,000,000.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 18 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 72 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 20 days of becoming aware of it.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $5,000,000.

Clause 4.1: the Escrow Amount shall be released to the Seller on the date falling 12 months after the Closing Date, save to the extent of pending claims notified before that date. 'Business Day' means a day other than a Saturday or Sunday on which banks are open in London.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $7,300,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $2,000,000.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $4,380,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $138,760,000.
